findings.evidence: Inspection of B-778 (supplier MedPack, Sterile syringe 5ml): seal integrity failure on sterile pouches, 3 of 500 units defective, defect_rate_pct 0.6, severity critical. Inspector notes: defect found inside sealed supplier cartons, and the supplier certificate of analysis is missing the seal-strength test. This indicates the defect existed before shipping. SH-2014 (BlueDart, Hyderabad to Chennai) was delivered on the promised date, 2026-10-07, with days_late 0.

policy_rules_applied: Rule 3: ESCALATE to the quality team when severity == 'critical' (any defect rate) OR defect_rate_pct >= 10. Findings: severity = critical (defect_rate_pct 0.6, 3 of 500 units), so escalation is required.
Rule 4: Priority P1 for critical severity.
Rule 2: root cause supplier_defect, because the defect was found inside sealed supplier cartons and the supplier certificate of analysis is missing the seal-strength test.
Rule 5: critical -> quarantine the batch and notify the supplier; supplier_defect -> raise a SCAR.
required_actions: Quarantine batch B-778 immediately
Notify supplier MedPack of the seal integrity failure
Raise a supplier corrective action request (SCAR) with MedPack, including the missing seal-strength test on the certificate of analysis
Escalate to the quality team as P1

Send Bloom Pharma (key account) a message that states the batch is quarantined and the quality team is investigating, and gives next steps. It must not promise any dates that no tool returned and must not blame named individuals.

communications.customer_message:
Dear Bloom Pharma team,

Thank you for flagging the broken pouch seals on batch B-778 (sterile syringes, shipment SH-2014). We apologise for this, and we understand how serious a sterile-barrier failure is.

Our inspection confirmed the issue: 3 of 500 inspected units (0.6%) had seal integrity failures. We have classed it as critical. The defects were found inside sealed supplier cartons, and the supplier's certificate of analysis does not include the seal-strength test. This points to the defect existing before shipping. The shipment itself arrived on the promised date, 2026-10-07.

What we are doing:
- Batch B-778 is being quarantined.
- The supplier has been notified of the seal integrity failure.
- We are raising a supplier corrective action request that includes the missing seal-strength test.
- Our quality team is investigating this as a P1 priority (reference ESC-17F0C0).

Next steps: Please do not use any units from B-778 and keep them segregated. Our quality team will contact you with the investigation findings and options for the affected batch. We have no confirmed dates to share yet, and we will not give you one until we can stand behind it.

Sincerely,
Customer Communications
communications.internal_note: T14 / Bloom Pharma (key account): B-778 (MedPack) seal failures, 3/500 (0.6%), critical, supplier_defect. Escalated to quality as P1 (ESC-17F0C0). Actions: quarantine B-778, notify MedPack, raise SCAR including missing seal-strength test on CoA. Delivery was on time (days_late 0). Customer told batch is quarantined and no dates promised.

required_actions: Raise a carrier damage claim with Ecom Express for SH-2016 (batch B-780, 4 of 100 inspected units defective, defect_rate_pct 4.0).

triage.summary: Acme Retail reports shipment SH-2018 arrived 3 days late and almost half the cartons (batch B-782) were crushed.

route_reasons: 2 exception types (late_shipment, quality_flag)
key account (Acme Retail)

findings.evidence: SH-2018 (Ecom Express) days_late=3, delivered 2026-10-08 vs promised 2026-10-05. Picked up at WH-AMD 2026-10-02 (left warehouse on time). Sat at Indore hub 2026-10-03 to 2026-10-06. Carrier status shows no declared disruptions; 30-day on-time rate 0.62.
B-782 inspection: 18 of 40 units defective, defect_rate_pct 45.0, crushed cartons, severity major. Notes: origin QC passed with photos; crush damage consistent with stacking during transit.

policy_rules_applied: Late shipment policy v3 rule 3: escalate to logistics when (days_late >= 3 AND key account). days_late=3 and customer tier=key_account, so escalation is required.
Late shipment policy v3 rule 4: P1 for key accounts.
Quality flag policy v2 rule 3: escalate to the quality team when severity == 'critical' OR defect_rate_pct >= 10. defect_rate_pct=45.0 (severity major), so escalation to quality is also required.
Quality flag policy v2 rule 4: P2 for non-critical severity. The higher priority (P1 from the late shipment) governs the combined ticket.
required_actions: Open a carrier trace with Ecom Express for SH-2018 (root cause carrier_delay, days_late=3, no declared disruption).
Waive freight charges for SH-2018 (key account with days_late >= 3).
Raise a carrier damage claim for batch B-782 (root cause damaged_in_transit, defect_rate_pct 45.0).
Also route the quality flag for B-782 to the quality team (P2 under quality policy). The submission form allows only one team, so logistics is the primary team and quality needs a separate handoff.
Send Acme Retail a customer message that acknowledges both issues and says what happens next. It must not promise any date that a tool did not return.

communications.customer_message:
Dear Acme Retail team,

We're sorry about shipment SH-2018. It reached you on 2026-10-08, 3 days after the promised date of 2026-10-05. A large share of the cartons in batch B-782 also arrived crushed. Our inspection found 18 of 40 units defective (45.0%). This is not the standard we aim to deliver, especially for a key account.

What we found: The shipment left our Ahmedabad warehouse on time on 2026-10-02. It then sat at the carrier's Indore hub from 2026-10-03 to 2026-10-06. The carrier declared no disruption. Our origin quality check on the batch passed, and the crush damage is consistent with stacking during transit.

What happens next:
- We have escalated this to our logistics team as a priority (reference ESC-25334E).
- We are opening a trace with the carrier, Ecom Express, on the delay.
- We are waiving the freight charges for SH-2018.
- We are raising a carrier damage claim for batch B-782.
- Our quality team is also being brought in on the B-782 damage.

We don't yet have confirmed dates for the claim outcome or for any replacement or credit for the damaged units. We will update you as soon as we have them, and we won't give you a date we can't stand behind.

Sincerely,
Customer Operations
communications.internal_note: ESC-25334E filed to logistics P1 (late shipment rule 3/4, key account, days_late=3). Actions: carrier trace with Ecom Express, waive freight on SH-2018, carrier damage claim for B-782 (45.0% defect, 18/40). FOLLOW-UP NEEDED: the form allows only one team, so a separate P2 handoff to the quality team for the B-782 quality flag (policy rule 3, defect_rate_pct >= 10) has not been filed. It must be routed manually. No dates promised to customer.

triage.summary: Delivery of SH-2019 failed twice because the courier couldn't find the customer, and the stock count for SKU-LED-40 at WH-PUNE doesn't match, which blocks sending a replacement.

route_reasons: 2 exception types (failed_delivery, inventory_mismatch)

findings.evidence: get_delivery_attempts: 2 failed attempts (2026-10-07, 2026-10-08), both reason_code address_not_found ('Building not found at given address'; 'address could not be located'); address_verified=false.

get_inventory: system_qty 200 vs physical_qty 188, variance_units -12, variance_pct -6.0. Movements show receipt GRN-551 of 12 units posted twice on 2026-10-03; dock log says one pallet, 12 units received. Last cycle count 2026-09-30 matched system (176).

policy_rules_applied: Inventory Mismatch Policy v2 rule 3: ESCALATE to warehouse_ops when abs(variance_pct) >= 5. variance_pct is -6.0 (system_qty 200 vs physical_qty 188, variance_units -12), so escalation is required.
Inventory Mismatch Policy v2 rule 4: P1 only if theft or loss is suspected, otherwise P2. The root cause is duplicate_posting, so the priority is P2.

Failed Delivery Policy v4 rule 3: ESCALATE to logistics only when failed_attempts >= 3 or the shipment is temperature_controlled. SH-2019 has failed_attempts 2 and temperature_controlled false, so it does not escalate on its own. Logistics is not engaged.
required_actions: Inventory (duplicate_posting): reverse the duplicate GRN-551 entry (12 units posted twice on 2026-10-03) for SKU-LED-40 at WH-PUNE.
Failed delivery (address_issue): contact the customer to verify the delivery address for SH-2019 before the next delivery attempt.

Customer message: tell Nova Electronics that we are verifying the address with them before the next attempt and that warehouse operations are correcting the stock record for the replacement LED panels. Do not promise any dates.

communications.customer_message:
Dear Nova Electronics team,

We're sorry about the failed deliveries of SH-2019 and the trouble with your replacement LED panels.

Delivery: The courier (Shadowfax) made two attempts, on 2026-10-07 and 2026-10-08. Both failed because the building could not be found at the address we have, and that address is not yet verified. Kind regards,
Customer Support
communications.internal_note: T19: Escalated to warehouse_ops P2 (ESC-AF0CE0). SKU-LED-40 at WH-PUNE variance -12 units (-6.0%), caused by GRN-551 posted twice on 2026-10-03; reverse the duplicate. SH-2019 had 2 failed attempts (address_not_found, address_verified=false). Below the logistics threshold of 3 attempts and not temperature-controlled, so logistics was not engaged. Action: contact the customer to verify the address before the next attempt. No dates promised to the customer.

triage.summary: Zest Foods reports order ORD-3020, due on the 8th, has not arrived and is overdue.

route_reasons: one exception type, standard/internal customer, order below threshold

findings.evidence: SH-2020 (TCI Express, Chennai to Coimbatore) is in_transit, days_late=2. Last event 2026-10-06 at Chennai hub: 'Held: linehaul suspended'. TCI Express declared a disruption at Chennai hub from 2026-10-06 to 2026-10-10: 'Cyclone advisory; all linehaul suspended'. The shipment was picked up at WH-CHN on 2026-10-05, so it left our warehouse.

policy_rules_applied: Rule 3: escalate to logistics only when (days_late >= 3 AND key account) OR days_late >= 7. Here days_late = 2 and customer tier = standard (not key_account), so neither condition is met: do not escalate.
Rule 2: root cause = carrier_hub_disruption (TCI Express declared a disruption at Chennai hub, and the shipment is held there).
Rule 4: priority P2 for non-key accounts.
required_actions: Open a carrier trace with TCI Express for SH-2020 (carrier hub disruption at Chennai hub).
No freight waiver: the waiver applies only to key accounts with days_late >= 3, and this is a standard account with days_late = 2.

Reply to the customer: ORD-3020 is delayed because of a carrier disruption at the Chennai hub. A carrier trace is open and we will update them on progress. Do not promise a delivery date, because no tool returned one.

communications.customer_message:
Hello Zest Foods team,

I'm sorry that order ORD-3020 has not arrived. It was due on the 8th, and it is now 2 days late.

Your shipment (SH-2020) left our Chennai warehouse on 2026-10-05 with TCI Express. It is being held at the carrier's Chennai hub. TCI Express has declared a disruption there from 2026-10-06 to 2026-10-10 because of a cyclone advisory, and all linehaul is suspended. The delay comes from that disruption and not from a problem with your order.

We are opening a carrier trace with TCI Express for this shipment. We will update you as we learn more. I can't give you a delivery date yet because the carrier hasn't confirmed one.

Thank you for your patience.
communications.internal_note: T20 / ORD-3020 / SH-2020: late shipment, 2 days late, standard account. Root cause is the TCI Express Chennai hub disruption (cyclone advisory, linehaul suspended 10-06 to 10-10). No escalation, because days_late is 2 and the account is not a key account. No freight waiver. Action: open a carrier trace with TCI Express and send the customer an update on progress. No delivery date promised.
